1172/1226
Field Name
Description
UserBruteForceAlert: User Brute Force
IncidentDescription
A description of the identity-based detection or incident name value.
Severity
Identity-based detection or incident severity number:
1: info
3: low
5: medium
7: high
SeverityName
Identity-based detection or incident severity name:
INFO
LOW
MEDIUM
HIGH
StartTime
Time of the first activity in the identity-based detection or incident.
EndTime
Time of the latest activity in the identity-based detection or incident.
UserName
If the compromised entity is a user, this field contains the username represented as domain\samAccountName, where
domain is the user’s domain, and samAccountName is the user’s Security Account Manager (SAM) account as defined in
Active Directory (AD).
EndpointName
Hostname if the compromised entity is a host and its hostname is known.
EndpointIp
Host IP address if the compromised entity is a host and its hostname is not known.
Always empty for a detection.
NumbersOfAlerts
Number of alerts in the identity-based incident.
Always has the value 1 for detections.
NumberOfCompromisedEntities
Number of compromised entities, users and endpoints.
FalconHostLink
URL to the incident details in Falcon Identity Protection
State
Identity-based detection or incident status:
NEW
IN_PROGRESS
DISMISS
RESOLVED
AUTO_RESOLVED
IdentityProtectionIncidentId
The ID of the detection or incident in Falcon Identity Protection.
